info.title: rvtio
info.description: Command line tool that reads Autodesk Revit files (.rvt, .rfa) without Revit and writes IFC or JSON.

options.name: --ifc
options.description: write IFC output to the specified path

options.name: --scene
options.description: write IOScene scene JSON to the specified path

options.name: --compact-json
options.description: write compact JSON (optionally to the specified path)

options.name: --full-json
options.description: write the full JSON dump to the specified path

options.name: --json
options.description: write JSON to the specified path (compact by default, full if --json-full)

options.name: --json-full
options.description: write the full JSON dump (every parameter and the geometry) instead of the compact JSON

options.name: --json-class-prefix
options.description: text put in front of the class names in the compact JSON "name" field

options.name: --ifc-profile
options.description: IFC output profile (default: current)

options.name: --ifc-revit-parameters
options.description: write the Revit parameters as IFC property sets

options.name: --ifc-revit-parameter-groups
options.description: write them as one property set per parameter group (implies --ifc-revit-parameters)

options.name: --ifc-no-base-quantities
options.description: leave out the base quantity sets

options.name: --ifc-opening-legacy-axes
options.description:
name the sides of the opening of a door or window by the frame they are measured in (Height
along the wall, Width vertical), as earlier releases did; by default the opening has the Width
(along the wall) and Height of the door or window, as Revit has them

options.name: --ifc-opening-host-axes
options.description: accepted and ignored: this is now the default

options.name: --ifc-phase
options.description:
phase whose state is exported: elements demolished at or before it or created after it and, unless
--ifc-room-phase says otherwise, rooms of other phases are left out. Default: the last phase for the
current profile, every phase for the legacy profile (IFC only)

options.name: --ifc-room-phase
options.description: rooms to export: the last phase, every phase or one native phase id (IFC only)

options.name: --ifc-length-unit
options.description:
length unit family written to the IFC file: mm (millimetre), m (metre) or ft (foot); default: the
unit stored in the project for the current profile, mm for the legacy profile (IFC only)

options.name: --ifc-timestamp
options.description: UTC timestamp for the STEP FILE_NAME header (ISO-8601 or Unix epoch seconds; IFC only)

options.name: --revit-localization
options.description: deprecated, ignored: the system family names are built in

options.name: --r22-layout
options.description: read the Revit 2022 layout for a JSON export too (an IFC export does it by default)

options.name: --no-r22-layout
options.description: keep the 64-bit schema path alone in an IFC export

options.name: --keep-all-copies
options.description:
decode every copy of an element that several partition streams hold, instead of only the current one
(a file saved in several increments; the current copy is kept by default)

options.name: --resolve-current-copies
options.description: the earlier opt-in for the default, accepted without effect

options.name: --report
options.description: write the JSON report of the run (read streams, limits, skipped elements, exported fraction)

options.name: --allow-partial
options.description: export what was read when a reader limit cut a stream (exit code 0 instead of 3)

options.name: --strict
options.description: fail when a read is partial even without hitting a limit (exit code 6 instead of 0; nothing is exported)

options.name: --raise-limits
--api-demo
options.description: print a tour of the document API

options.name: --inspect
options.description: print identity, parameters and geometry counts of elements

options.name: --diag-dump
options.description: hex dump of the blocks of elements

options.name: --find-str
options.description: find a UTF-16 text in the decompressed partition chunks

options.name: --sketch-owner-dump
options.description: write the closed sketch loops of every sketch-owning element

options.name: --inspect-batch
options.description: inspect many ids in one pass (ids: one per line or comma separated)

options.name: --list-category
options.description:
list the elements of one category
sheets <file.rvt|file.rfa> [output.json] [--r22-layout] [--where FILTER] [--params] [--csv] [--json]
write the sheet catalog (sheets, viewports, parameters, limits not decoded) as JSON
print <file.rvt> <out.pdf> [--level <id|name>] [--view <id|name>] [--sheet <id|number>] [--where FILTER] [--scale <n>]
[--all-views] [--all-sheets] [--paper A4|A3|A2|A1|A0]
[--list-levels] [--list-views] [--list-sheets]
render the plan of one level, one or more views (plans and elevations) or all of
them, or one or more sheets, to PDF
Developer options (measurement and comparison dumps, not a stable interface):

options.name: --dev-external-dump
options.description: text dump of the model for CompoundStructure layers

options.name: --dev-external-dump-prefix
options.description: class name prefix in that dump

options.name: --dev-candidates
options.description: compact JSON: write every listed parameter before the value gate

options.name: --dev-trace
options.description: compact JSON: write why each listed parameter was written or dropped

options.name: --dev-facts
options.description: compact JSON: write the facts that decide the phase parameters

options.name: --dev-fact-names
options.description: extra facts for --dev-facts

options.name: --dev-user-params
options.description: compact JSON: write the parameter definitions of the file

options.name: --dev-collisions
options.description: compact JSON: write user parameters that share a group and label

options.name: --dev-solids
options.description: compact JSON: write the solid quantities; with --dev-solids-only stop after it

options.name: --dev-native
options.description:
compact JSON: print the native record of elements
downgrade <source.rvt> --target-profile <file> --check [--guid-rule exact|minimal] [--report <report.json>]
(first argument) plan the class table edit that would let an older release load a newer
project and report it; the profile is a project or family saved by that older release;
writes nothing but the report; exit code 5 when the releases are out of scope
save-as <source.rvt|source.rfa> [<output.rvt|output.rfa>] [--check] [--report <report.json>]
(first argument) inspect the write-capability matrix (--check) or write a verified lossless
copy of a local 2020-2027 project or family; exit code 5 when refused by the matrix
coverage <file.rvt> [--report <report.json>] [--top <n>]
(first argument) count the records of the partition streams that the class schema of the
file walks to their last byte, per channel and class; writes nothing but the report
coverage <file.rvt> --trace <class|owner,...> [--trace-reason <text>] [--trace-max <n>] [--trace-channel <n>]
[--trace-bytes <n>] [--trace-family]
(developer aid) print the field walk of single records instead of counting them

options.name: --schema-dump
options.description: (first argument) write the class schema embedded in a file

options.name: --schema-check
options.description: (first argument) validate a class schema

options.name: --schema-diff
options.description: (first argument) compare two class schemas

options.name: --rebar-dump
options.description: (first argument) dump rebar records

options.name: --parse-block
options.description: (first argument) decode raw geometry block files

options.name: --elemtable-diag
options.description: [--sweep n] [--pin1 n] [--force idx:delta,...] [--dump-partial]

options.name: --class-census
options.description: --episode-check <ids>  --test-decoders <gzfile>

options.name: --dump-storage
options.description: <dir>  --name-scan  --typemap  --block-map  --block-dump <0xCLASS>

options.name: --decode-blocks
options.description: --search-global <text>  --hex-search <hex>  --chunk-dump <idx>:<off>:<len>

options.name: --block-scan
options.description: --grep-inspect <ids>
